projection: Equal Earth, central meridian 0°; scale 179, origin (500,259). South polar continent omitted.
source: Natural Earth, 1:50m Admin 0 Map Units and Countries; 1:10m Admin 0 Label Points.
notes: Coordinates are SVG viewBox units. Empty paths use point markers. ISO 3166-1 codes plus XK; world overview excludes Antarctica. Siachen Glacier is unassigned. Somaliland and northern Cyprus are grouped by ISO territory. Jan Mayen is grouped with Svalbard. US Minor Outlying Islands marker represents Midway. Fill polygon paths using evenodd.
